title: $1,000 in Netflix in 2012 is now worth this
caption:
In 2012, Netflix was recovering from a stock crash.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:NFLX:2012-01-03} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Netflix in 2012? 👇
sources: Netflix price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time
